tasks.name: cargo_default_features
tasks.prompt: Write every feature that is enabled in the manifest to output.txt, comma separated.

none: const on = []; read_file('Cargo.toml').split('\n').forEach((line) => { const at = line.indexOf(' = true'); if (at > 0) on.push(line.slice(0, at)); }); write_file('output.txt', on.join(',') + '\n'); 'ok'

library: const l = parseToml(read_file('lock.toml')); write_file('output.txt', l.name + '@' + l.version + ' ' + l.checksum + '\n'); 'ok'

tasks.name: csv_quoted_field
tasks.prompt: Split the quoted CSV line into fields and write them pipe separated to output.txt.

none: const line = read_file('quoted.csv').split('\n')[0]; const out = []; let field = '', quoted = false; for (let i = 0; i < line.length; i++) { const c = line[i]; if (c === '"') quoted = !quoted; else if (c === ',' && !quoted) { out.push(field); field = ''; } else field += c; } out.push(field); write_file('output.txt', out.join('|') + '\n'); 'ok'

tasks.name: suite_summary_table
tasks.prompt: Format the suite result rows as an aligned table in output.txt.

expected_files.output.txt:
suite   | result
js      | pass
sandbox | pass

none: const rows = JSON.parse(read_file('suite.json')); const cell = (row, i) => String(row[i] == null ? '' : row[i]); const width = rows.length === 0 ? 0 : Math.max(...rows.map((row) => row.length)); const cols = Array.from({length: width}, (_, i) => Math.max(...rows.map((row) => cell(row, i).length))); const text = rows.map((row) => cols.map((n, i) => cell(row, i).padEnd(n)).join(' | ').replace(/\s+$/, '')).join('\n'); write_file('output.txt', text + '\n'); 'ok'
